message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some top sushi spots in Los Angeles (in no particular order):

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|-------------|
| **Sushi Ginza On Seventh** | West Hollywood | Classic omakase, high‑end experience, Michelin‑starred chef. |
| **KazuNori** | Downtown / Westside | Known for its “sushi burrito” style rolls and creative flavor combos. |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s flagship – upscale, signature dishes like black cod miso. |
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Traditional Edomae style, excellent nigiri, great value for the quality. |
| **Umi** | West Hollywood | Contemporary take on Japanese cuisine, seasonal tasting menus. |
| **Sushi Ota** | Koreatown | Hidden gem, authentic hand‑rolled rolls, friendly service. |

If you’re looking for something more casual or budget‑friendly, check out places like **Sushi Katsu** (famous for their spicy tuna roll) or **Sushi Tetsu** (known for fresh fish and a relaxed vibe). For a truly unique experience, consider booking a private omakase dinner at one of the Michelin‑starred spots. Enjoy your culinary adventure!
